name: Auth0
tagline: Identity platform with OAuth/OIDC, MFA, and social login APIs for authentication and user management.
description: Auth0 is a cloud identity platform that provides authentication, authorization, and user management via OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, MFA, social logins, and a Management API. Developers integrate Auth0 into apps to handle login, signup, passwordless flows, and role-based access without building identity infrastructure. Tenant-specific API hosts and the Authentication/Management APIs support production identity workloads.

auth.details: Authentication API: public/confidential client credentials and tokens (OAuth 2.0/OIDC). Management API: Bearer access token (Machine-to-Machine client credentials) in Authorization header. Self-serve signup at auth0.com.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan available (limits vary by plan; check pricing for MAU/feature caps — verify current numbers on pricing page)
pricing.paid_plans: Essentials, Professional, Enterprise — usage-based (MAUs and features); see auth0.com/pricing

rate_limits: Published per-endpoint Management API rate limits (tenant-dependent); Authentication API has separate limits — see Auth0 rate limit docs
